mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.payload_hash, r.policy_code, r.received_at, o.event_id::text AS delivery_event_id, o.status AS delivery_status FROM diagnostic_result r LEFT JOIN outbox_event o ON o.result_id = r.id WHERE r.device_id = #{deviceId} AND r.event_id = #{eventId}

INSERT INTO diagnostic_result (device_id, event_id, payload_hash, brand, vin, session_id, occurred_at, policy_code, raw_payload) VALUES (#{cmd.deviceId}, #{cmd.eventId}, #{payloadHash}, #{cmd.brand}, #{cmd.vin}, #{cmd.sessionId}, #{cmd.occurredAt}, #{policyCode}, #{rawPayload}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (device_id, event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING id, received_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ecu_observation (result_id, ecu_id, sw_version, dtc_codes) VALUES
(#{r.resultId}, #{r.ecuId}, #{r.swVersion}, #{r.dtcCodes,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::text[])

INSERT INTO vehicle_ecu_latest (vin, ecu_id, result_id, occurred_at, dtc_codes, updated_at) VALUES (#{vin}, #{ecuId}, #{resultId}, #{occurredAt}, #{dtcCodes,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}::text[], now()) ON CONFLICT (vin, ecu_id) DO UPDATE SET result_id = EXCLUDED.result_id, occurred_at = EXCLUDED.occurred_at, dtc_codes = EXCLUDED.dtc_codes, updated_at = now() WHERE (vehicle_ecu_latest.occurred_at, vehicle_ecu_latest.result_id) < (EXCLUDED.occurred_at, EXCLUDED.result_id)
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, event_id, brand, vin, session_id, occurred_at, received_at, policy_code FROM diagnostic_result WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT result_id, ecu_id, sw_version, dtc_codes FROM ecu_observation WHERE result_id = #{resultId} ORDER BY ecu_id
